name: Gyomei Himejima
classification: Human; Demon Slayer; Hashira; Stone Hashira
summary: Gyomei Himejima is the Stone Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps and is regarded as the strongest member of his generation. Despite being blind since childhood, Gyomei possesses extraordinary hearing and sensory perception that allow him to perceive his surroundings and accurately track his opponents. He fights using a chained spiked flail and axe and is the most skilled known user of Stone Breathing. His immense physical strength, combat experience, and exceptional senses make him one of the most formidable Demon Slayers.

stats.range: Several Meters with his chained spiked flail and axe and Breathing Styles

abilities: Master Spiked Flail and Axe Wielder
notes: Gyomei is blind, but compensates through his exceptionally developed hearing and extrasensory perception. He is the most skilled known user of Stone Breathing and fights with a chained spiked flail and axe rather than a conventional Nichirin sword. His weapon is made from sunlight-absorbing material and can inflict severe damage to demons.
